subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> — 钱经理: a 45-year-old male property manager. Slightly overweight, slicked-back oily hair, round face, an ingratiating smile that flips into a scowl, white shirt buttoned to the closed collar under a dark grey buttoned waistcoat, dark grey trousers, black leather shoes. His voice is loud, nasal and bullying, standard Mandarin. It is the person shown in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> — 苏小满: a 25-year-old female cleaner. Preserve her exact face, small lean build, centre-parted black hair in a low practical ponytail, plain dark-navy button-up work shirt buttoned to the closed collar with small plain buttons down the front, a worn grey apron over dark navy trousers, black cloth shoes. Her voice is low, steady and slightly hoarse, standard Mandarin. It is the person shown in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> — 小唐: a 22-year-old female cleaning-team colleague. Thin, pale, narrow shoulders, shifty sidelong eyes, hair tied back in a low ponytail, light-grey button-up work shirt with a pointed collar and matching light-grey trousers, a light-grey apron tied round her waist, black cloth shoes. Her voice is small, thin and nervous. It is the person shown in <Picture 3>.
<Picture 4>: the office layout reference for 万山大厦 — this same single room is the set for the whole clip. Light-oak storage cabinets along the back-left wall with plain brown cardboard boxes stacked on top; a low wooden credenza under the back window with a printer, files and two potted green plants; an L-shaped wooden office desk with a black monitor, keyboard and document tray in the middle of the room, a black swivel chair pushed in; a grey fabric sofa with wooden armrests and a low wooden coffee table under the long window on the right; an open doorway with a grey metal frame on the left. Pale grey polished tile floor, white acoustic ceiling with recessed light panels.

summary:
[reference generation] Interior of a bright property office at midday. The manager slams his palm down and names an expensive accusation; the cleaner stands her ground and says nothing; the colleague by the sofa does not move.

detailed_description:
HORIZONTAL 4:3 landscape framing, high-key commercial cinematography, soft broad daylight, luminous pale walls, light reflective floor, every surface clearly readable. Keep the film texture, natural lighting, every face, every costume and the realistic motion consistent throughout. People stay standing, framed from the knees up.
Exposure: the long right-hand window is the key light and soft bounced daylight fills the room; skin tones are bright and even, shadows sit in the light mid-tones, the whites stay white, and the picture carries an even high-key brightness from edge to edge. Every shirt and waistcoat is buttoned right up to the closed collar, so each chest shows one continuous unbroken run of plain fabric with its own small plain buttons down the front. Apron bibs are plain unmarked fabric.
Speaker labels for this shot only: (S1) 苏小满, (S3) 钱经理, (S4) 小唐. Anyone not named here stays completely silent with a closed mouth.
The whole clip takes place in the one office shown in <Picture 4>, and the three of them hold these same standing places from the first frame to the last: 钱经理 (S3) behind the L-shaped desk in the middle of the room, three-quarters to the camera; 苏小满 (S1) at the near left corner of that desk in right profile facing right towards him, both feet flat on the tile; 小唐 (S4) on the right side of the room beside the grey sofa in left profile, facing left towards the desk.

[Shot 1] Static Shot, medium-wide three-shot across the desk: 钱经理 (S3) takes one quick step forward behind the desk and slams his palm flat on the wood; 苏小满 (S1) is at the near left corner of the desk in right profile with her feet planted and does not move; 小唐 (S4) stands beside the grey sofa at frame right, watching.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.250, Camera: Static Shot, holding a medium shot of 钱经理 (S3) behind the desk as he keeps his palm on the wood, lifts his chin and opens his mouth to speak in a loud bullying nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 三楼包厢。

[Shot 3] At 00:02.500, Camera: Push In with small amplitude at fast speed, pushing in tighter on 钱经理 (S3) as a band of blind-light crosses his chest and he leans over the desk, still speaking in the same loud nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 贵客丢了一只金耳钉。

[Shot 4] At 00:03.750, Camera: Truck Right with medium amplitude at fast speed, sliding sideways along the desk to a profile two-shot: 苏小满 (S1) in right profile in the near foreground, 钱经理 (S3) across the wood from her with his hand still flat, still speaking in the same loud nasal Mandarin: [Chinese] 三万八。

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, Camera: Static Shot, holding a medium shot of 小唐 (S4) beside the grey sofa as she lowers her eyes, her fingers closing on the sofa's wooden arm and her jaw setting tight; she stays exactly where she stands. The camera is locked off and does not move, push, swing, or travel in this beat.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, Camera: Pull Out with large amplitude at slow speed, pulling out to the full room: the folder lying flat at the middle of the desk, 钱经理 (S3) bearing down on it from behind the desk, 苏小满 (S1) still in profile at the near left corner of the desk, 小唐 (S4) still beside the sofa at frame right.

From [Shot 5] onward every mouth in frame is closed, the line is finished, and the office falls into room tone.

No slow-motion, no soft dissolves, no fades, no unnecessary transitions; use hard cuts only and no on-screen text, letters, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.

overall_soundscape: A clock ticking on the wall and the low hum of the ceiling lights throughout; one sharp heel strike at 0.4s as 钱经理 steps forward; a flat palm slap on the desk top at 1.0s; room tone returns at 5.2s.

non_diegetic_music: A low sustained string drone enters at 0s, a single wood-block knock lands with the palm slap at 1.0s, and the track thins to one held note from 5.2s onward.
